name: Company and Enterprise Group Boundary
constraints: Company is a constrained organization view and never a parallel organization identity.
Every group boundary is purpose-, kind-, interval- and evidence-qualified.
Management, consolidation, control, statistical, franchise and alliance perimeters remain separate graphs.
Shared brand, name, site or affiliation never proves identity, control or consolidation.
Membership records role, basis, authority, claimant capacity, source master and dispute status.
Derived perimeter membership remains labelled, dated and reproducible and never replaces asserted membership.
A perimeter grants no authority over member facts and cannot bind a member.
Merger, split, sale and succession require explicit continuity decisions.
Statistical and consolidation units never merge organization masters.
